import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    dr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]; dc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(g[i][c] for i in range(H)))==1]
    def segs(divs,n):
        res=[]; s=-1
        for p in [-1]+divs+[n]:
            if p>s: res.append((s+1,p))
            s=p
        return res
    R=segs(dr,H); C=segs(dc,W)
    # per block marker count, only counting NON-marker-colored cells? markers here are color 4
    blk={}
    for bi,(r0,r1) in enumerate(R):
        for bj,(c0,c1) in enumerate(C):
            p=sum(1 for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if g[i][j]!=bg)
            pos=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if g[i][j]!=bg]
            blk[(bi,bj)]=(p,pos)
    print('counts:',{kk:p for kk,(p,_) in blk.items()})
    mx=max(blk.values())
    wins=[kk for kk,v in blk.items() if v==mx]
    # pick region with most non-bg cells? that's it. tie-break by... choose smallest area? or the one whose marker is unique?
    areas={kk:(R[kk[0]][1]-R[kk[0]][0],C[kk[1]][1]-C[kk[1]][0]) for kk in wins}
    print('wins',wins,'areas',{kk:v for kk,v in areas.items()})
    # marker color of winning region
    best=min(wins,key=lambda kk:areas[kk][0]*areas[kk][1]) if len(wins)>1 else wins[0]
    mark=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(R[best[0]][0],R[best[0]][1]) for j in range(C[best[1]][0],C[best[1]][1]) if g[i][j]!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if i in dr or j in dc: continue
            bi=sum(1 for d in dr if d<i); bj=sum(1 for d in dc if d<j)
            if (bi,bj)==best: out[i][j]=mark
            else: out[i][j]=bg
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
ti=G['Test input']
print(json.dumps(solve(ti)))
